verdict.rationale: YYLO Skills is an agent skills package. A buyer could reasonably ask whether it offers a sandbox mode, so the axis applies. The pack documents no sandbox environment or test-versus-production data separation for Ledger, Ralph-loop, or other skill operations. The only related item is an isolated configuration directory for validating an unpublished plugin checkout. That is an adjacent install-testing practice that protects the user's settings, not a sandbox that keeps production data untouched, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: To validate an unpublished checkout without changing your normal settings, use an isolated configuration directory and a local marketplace path
